title: Unity in the Body of Christ, The New Life

questions.question: I therefore, a prisoner for the Lord, urge you to walk in a manner ____ of the calling to which you have been called.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:1 (ESV): "I therefore, a prisoner for the Lord, urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling to which you have been called,"

questions.question: Walk with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in ____,
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:2 (ESV): "with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,"

questions.question: Eager to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the bond of ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:3 (ESV): "eager to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace."

questions.question: There is one body and one Spirit... one Lord, one ____, one baptism.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:4-5 (ESV): "There is one body and one Spirit... one Lord, one faith, one baptism,"

questions.question: But ____ was given to each one of us according to the measure of Christ's gift.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:7 (ESV): "But grace was given to each one of us according to the measure of Christ's gift."

questions.question: He gave the apostles, the prophets, the evangelists, the shepherds and teachers, to equip the saints for ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:11-12 (ESV): "And he gave the apostles, the prophets, the evangelists, the shepherds and teachers, to equip the saints for the work of ministry, for building up the body of Christ,"

questions.question: The saints are equipped until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to mature manhood, to the measure of the stature of the ____ of Christ.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:13 (ESV): "until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to mature manhood, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,"

questions.question: So that we may no longer be children, tossed to and fro by the waves and carried about by every wind of ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:14 (ESV): "so that we may no longer be children, tossed to and fro by the waves and carried about by every wind of doctrine, by human cunning, by craftiness in deceitful schemes."

questions.question: Rather, speaking the ____ in love, we are to grow up in every way into him who is the head, into Christ.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:15 (ESV): "Rather, speaking the truth in love, we are to grow up in every way into him who is the head, into Christ,"

questions.question: You must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the ____ of their minds.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:17 (ESV): "Now this I say and testify in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their minds."

questions.question: Put off your ____ self, which belongs to your former manner of life and is corrupt through deceitful desires.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:22 (ESV): "to put off your old self, which belongs to your former manner of life and is corrupt through deceitful desires,"

questions.question: And to be renewed in the spirit of your ____,
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:23 (ESV): "and to be renewed in the spirit of your minds,"

questions.question: Be angry and do not sin; do not let the ____ go down on your anger.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:26 (ESV): "Be angry and do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger,"

questions.question: Let no corrupting ____ come out of your mouths, but only such as is good for building up.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:29 (ESV): "Let no corrupting talk come out of your mouths, but only such as is good for building up, as fits the occasion, that it may give grace to those who hear."

questions.question: And do not ____ the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:30 (ESV): "And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption."

key_verse_text: Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ forgave you.
